benefits.title: Students recognise and can articulate more of the value they gain at King’s
benefits.statement: A clearer and more consistently activated graduate premium proposition helps students connect their course, wider experiences, skills and ambitions and describe the value they are building with greater confidence.
benefits.beneficiary: Current students and the staff who support them
benefits.owner: 2.4.4 delivery lead with student-facing and marketing partners
benefits.realisationPeriod: From 2026/27, scaling across the mobilisation period
benefits.successLooksLike: The proposition is visible at meaningful points in the student journey, staff use coherent language around it, and student research shows stronger recognition and articulation of the value of the King’s experience.

benefits.title: King’s converts graduate premium evidence into stronger external recognition and market traction
benefits.statement: Evidence-backed claims and stories are deliberately activated with priority external audiences, strengthening awareness, credibility and distinctiveness rather than remaining as unused content assets.
benefits.beneficiary: King’s, prospective students, families, employers, alumni and partners
benefits.owner: 2.4.4 delivery lead with central and faculty marketing, communications and engagement partners
benefits.realisationPeriod: Early testing in 2026/27, with material scaling from 2027/28
benefits.successLooksLike: Priority audiences encounter a clearer and more distinctive graduate premium proposition, tested activation approaches show evidence of traction, and the strongest routes are incorporated into ongoing recruitment, reputation and engagement activity.

benefits.title: King’s improves performance in strategically important outcomes and reputation surveys
benefits.statement: High-value surveys are managed as strategic performance environments, with targeted interventions used to improve representation of positive graduate destinations and strengthen recognition among audiences whose perceptions shape employability and reputation measures.
benefits.owner: 2.4.4 delivery lead with Careers, Planning, Analytics and reputation partners
benefits.realisationPeriod: Graduate Outcomes interventions from 2026/27; broader reputation-survey optimisation developing across Years 2 and 3
benefits.successLooksLike: Graduate Outcomes response-rate interventions are targeted using evidence and evaluated for effect, particularly in areas with strong positive destinations, while priority external surveys have explicit performance strategies, understood levers and annual review cycles.
